description: Selected VAD, live STT and speaker-embedding models load in the background as soon as the app boots (and again after post-processing releases the ASR worker, and when the selection changes), not when a conversation starts. While they're still loading the glasses say so (idle page and while recording) so the user knows captions will be delayed; starting a recording is never blocked by loading.

comments.text: Landed in jj revision nkprtuuv (workspace model-warmup, on ulxzskxq). ModelWarmup in provider-local; PostProcessor.idle/busy; glasses + LiveView loading lines. Known gaps: status stays 'ready' after Settings download/benchmark release until warm() is called; not run on sim/glasses yet.

title: Warm live models at app launch; show loading state on glasses
